description: Names the business's own characters, when it has any: a mascot, a host, a narrator, the recurring cast of its channel. Each with who it is in a sentence, and each look it is drawn in (a 3D render, a flat drawing, a plush, a costume), with how that look differs. Then send pictures of every look with add_pictures or get_upload_link, giving character and look: each picture becomes that character in that look, which Create lists first under Characters and every picture and film keeps exactly as pictured. A name already on file is updated, never doubled (looks merge by name). Works during setup and after it (give project when no setup is open). Never a real person who isn't the business's own presenter. Spends nothing.

characters.description: One or more characters, each with its name, who it is and its looks.

looks.description: Each look it is drawn in; one look with an empty name for a character with only one.

name.description: The look's name: "3D", "drawn flat", "plush". Empty for a character with one look.

words.description: How this look differs, in a few words.

name.description: Its own name, as the business writes it.

what.description: Who it is, in a sentence: what it does for the business and how it behaves.

project.description: Only with no setup open: the project's id or exact name.

name: add_characters
title: Name the business's own characters
